headline: Your next visit starts here.
items: Agree on dates and a budget.
title: Long-Distance Reunion Checklist: Plan Your Next Visit Together
description: Planning a visit with your long-distance partner? Copy this checklist into a shared note, agree on travel costs, and leave room to rest. Includes a sample weekend and a free reunion countdown.
alt_text: Foxy accompanies a reunion checklist: agree on dates and a budget, plan arrival, leave time to do nothing, and choose your next check-in.

headline: Talk money before you book.
items: Choose a split you can afford.
title: Planning a Long-Distance Visit? Start With a Shared Budget
description: Tickets are one part of a reunion budget. Talk about accommodation, food, and transport before either of you books. Use Far Fox's visit checklist to make a plan that works for both of you.
alt_text: Foxy beside four visit-budget prompts: count the whole trip, choose an affordable split, allow for changes, and plan within the budget.

headline: A weekend with room for you.
title: A Relaxed Reunion Weekend for Long-Distance Couples
description: You don't need to book each hour of your reunion. Try this weekend outline with time for an outing, a meal at home, and rest. Read the full planning guide and make a countdown for your next visit.
alt_text: Foxy with a sample reunion weekend: settle in Friday, choose a Saturday outing, leave an evening free, and plan a calm Sunday departure.
